# Marky v1.7.2

The graph view got rebuilt. It was drawn once and frozen; now it runs live, and
you can push it around.

### Fixed

- **Zoom follows your cursor.** Scrolling used to scale the graph about its
  origin, so unless you happened to be dead centre, zooming in threw whatever
  you were looking at off the edge of the panel. The point under the pointer now
  stays under the pointer.
- **Zoom steps are even.** Each notch moved a fixed amount regardless of scale,
  which crawled when you were zoomed in and lurched when you were zoomed out. It
  is proportional now, so one notch feels the same everywhere. A trackpad pinch
  is recognised separately from a scroll and zooms harder.
- **Panning no longer drops the drag.** Moving the cursor off the canvas
  mid-drag used to abandon the pan. It follows the pointer until you release.
- **The layout no longer steals the view.** The graph tidies its framing once
  when it settles. If you had already started panning, that tidy-up yanked the
  view back. Touch the canvas and it leaves you alone.
- **Wide windows get wide graphs.** The layout was squeezed into a fixed square
  regardless of the panel's shape, so a maximised window showed a small round
  blob with dead margins on both sides. It now uses the whole canvas.
- **Hairlines and labels hold their size.** Edges thinned to nothing when you
  zoomed out and labels grew to headline size when you zoomed in, because both
  scaled with the graph. They are drawn at a constant size on screen now, and
  labels step out of the way below 45%.

### Added

- **Drag a node.** Grab one and the layout wakes up, moves out of its way, and
  settles again when you let go. Previously a drag anywhere panned the canvas.
- **The layout animates.** It runs incrementally instead of solving 200
  iterations in one blocking pass on open, so the graph settles in front of you
  rather than appearing finished.
- **Double-click to fit**, and a **Redraw** button that lays the graph out again
  from scratch when a settle lands badly. Redraw replaces Reset, which sent the
  graph off screen now that the layout is not boxed in.
- A dot grid behind the canvas, so panning reads as movement.
- Bigger click targets on small nodes, and a wider panel to put them in.

### Changed

- Node size uses square-root scaling on incoming links, so the difference
  between one backlink and four is visible without a hub of twenty swallowing
  its neighbours. Exported SVG and PNG use the same sizing, so an export matches
  what was on screen.

### Documentation

- The README claimed a backlinks panel with context previews. There is no such
  panel — backlinks show as counts in the notes tree and as node sizes in the
  graph, which is what it says now.

### Downloads

- macOS Apple Silicon: `aarch64` DMG. macOS Intel: `x64` DMG.
- Windows: setup EXE or MSI for your architecture.
- Linux: AppImage, DEB, or RPM for your architecture.

macOS builds are not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID. If macOS says the
app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Marky.app` once after installing.
